note: East Bay Regional Park District campground (opened 2021) in a reclaimed quarry at the Dumbarton Bridge (CA-84) approach in Fremont, beside Coyote Hills Regional Park; camp store, amphitheater, playground and Wi-Fi. Sites are on paved pads except three unpaved water-only sites. Despite the name, the open Bay is about 3 km west past salt ponds. --Claude
summary: Dumbarton Quarry (EBRPD, local): ebparks campground + park page + 2021 brochure + alerts + imagery (ReserveAmerica 403). $45-65 + $8 reservation fee confirmed; 63 sites (60 full 50A paved); year-round; 12-week window, 15-night max; no dump station (written false). Lakeview -> not waterfront lead (the 'lake' is a ~3.6-acre pond ~100 m away past a parking lot). Not price-gated (local).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade, lakeview -> not waterfront): the stored evidence ('RV pad rows face the quarry lake across open lawn but a large paved parking lot ... ~75 m pad-to-water') describes the pond north of the campground.
